title: The Shortest War in History Was Over in About 40 Minutes

scenes.text: The shortest war in history was over before most people finished breakfast.
August twenty-seventh, eighteen ninety-six. Zanzibar, East Africa. The sultan had just died, and a prince Britain did not approve of took the palace.
Britain told him to leave. He refused. So British warships gathered in the harbour as the clock ticked towards nine.
At two minutes past nine, they opened fire. By about a quarter to ten, the palace flag was down and the shooting had stopped.
It ended so fast because a palace and a few old guns stood no chance against modern naval artillery.
Roughly forty minutes, start to finish. Some meetings last longer. What's the strangest war you've heard of?

description:
The shortest war in recorded history lasted about 40 minutes.
On 27 August 1896, after a prince Britain did not approve of seized the sultan's palace in Zanzibar, British warships opened fire at 9:02 in the morning. By roughly 9:40 the palace flag was down and the fighting was over.
It ended so quickly because a palace and a few old guns were no match for modern naval artillery.
What is the strangest war you have ever heard of?
